newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA rice export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 18,500 MT were one-third below the week earlier and 4 percent under the 4-week average. Mexico (8,700 MT, of which 8,400 MT was rough), the Netherlands (4,300 MT), Barbados (1,500 MT), Saudi Arabia (1,400 MT), and Yemen (1,000 MT) were the primary buyers.
Sales of 16,500 MT for delivery in the 1997/98 marketing year were mainly for the Dominican Republic (10,000 MT), and Mexico (5,800 MT, of which 5,000 MT was rough).

Exports of 10,600 MT were down 69 percent from the previous week and 74 percent from the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Saudi Arabia (3,100 MT), Mexico (2,300 MT), Canada (1,800 MT), and Belgium (1,300 MT).
